unit: compatible dependency body updates: startup-index and custom-output route
scope: Operational summary only; no application names, source, private paths, raw prompts/answers, host/process identity or live data.
source: Held complete official Quarkus3.40.1.1 and Java21 sources plus the actual current launch/config and a separately qualified earlier fixture.
mode: Two distinct ordinary HTTP three-message tasks; output caps4500/5000. Both one-attempt stop/DONE, no retry.
owner_review: Both partial only, no model code/whole approval adopted. Correct enable/index direction was checked against source. Rejected conflation of missing class metadata with a missing whole index, unchanged public signatures with compiled-schema compatibility, and a false assertion that public runtime toggle/setter methods do not exist. Source-level APIs do not prove a control endpoint is reachable/authorized in a particular disabled-console host.
new_software_boundary: A prior fixture already proved standard-vendor indexed dependency method-body instrumentation using default output paths. The new single private Maven first combined custom buildRoot/artifactId outputs for host and dependency, explicit initial artifact indexing and a forceC2 request. Same PID/birth, app+dependency loader, delegate identity and worker thread persisted; original worker and fresh invocation observed changed body, counter progressed, compiled class bytes changed, no class add/delete, official instrumentation/no-restart log, normal nonce stop/one close+join/portfree. This is not a toy ClassLoader or a rerun under old conditions.
operational_rules: Compare actual compiled schema, including private/synthetic methods, fields and annotations; a source-body edit adding a lambda may still require restart.
Public setters/toggles, reachable official controls and coherent application adoption are different claims. Resource=true does not itself prove a running explicit CLI=false host changed.

Initial artifact-index configuration feeds the startup index. An absent explicit property does not prove actual index membership is missing; full application indexing may also affect augmentation/CDI.

Redefinition leaves active stack frames executing old bytecode. The positive covers repeated new calls of a finite dependency method from a preserved worker, not replacement of arbitrary active loops.

cost.setup_errors: Two guessed held source paths absent and one pre-execution Python syntax typo corrected; no host, model or compiler failure was attributed to them.

nonclaims: No actual business/source-authority integration, current host config or endpoint operation, new-type support, speed/saved-day improvement, or formal production adoption. C2 was requested, not an effective-tier/method-tier observation. Current-style small fixture does not qualify indexing a whole production artifact.
